pr_title: Fix failures in build_essential on rhel platforms
pr_body:
- fixes bug inside the action which was breaking build_essential on rhel
- wires up some more testing in the provider resolver spec
- adds a property that we can turn on so that this kind of breakage will raise an error in our end-to-end testing

i'm not entirely sure raise_if_unsupported true should be the default behavior, but that would be a breaking change and we definitely need to be able to bypass that for testing.

closes #9107

issue_context.title: build_essential failing to run for CentOS
issue_context.body:
## Description
Using the build_essential on a CentOS 7 node now gives the following:

```
* build_essential[default] action install[2019-11-18T10:18:48-05:00] WARN:         The build_essential resource does not currently support the 'rhel' platform family. Skipping...
```

It would appear that the fedora_derived definition is not correctly encompassing RHEL platforms.

## Chef Version
Chef Infra Client version 15.5.9

## Platform Version
  "platform": "centos",
  "platform_version": "7.6.1810",
  "platform_family": "rhel",

## Replication Case
- Create a CentOS client.
- Run a cookbook that requires the build_essential resource.

## Client Output

The debug output (chef-client -l debug) may be useful, but please link to a gist, or truncate it. -->

```

```
